dict.string: Atoll uses Apple Music to fetch animated artwork for the lock screen wallpaper.

Atoll captures system audio only when you start audio transcription in the AI assistant, and also uses live audio for music visualization and per-app volume. Assistant audio is transcribed and is not stored by Atoll.
Atoll uses the camera only when you request a snapshot for the AI assistant.
Atoll uses the microphone only when you start dictation for the AI assistant.
Atoll needs screen recording permission when you capture screenshots or transcribe system audio for the AI assistant.
Atoll converts microphone or system audio speech into text for the AI assistant when you request it.
